surface_mechanism_description: Methane plasma provided carbon to enhance the formation of the TaC phase and at the same time suppressed the formation of the nitride phase.
evidence: As the methane concentration was increased, the TaC phase was increased and the TaN phase was decreased. This result clearly shows that methane plasma provided carbon to enhance the formation of the TaC phase and at the same time suppressed the formation of the nitride phase.
